source_review.notes: Checked the current IEEE SystemVerilog standard record, author resources for digital architecture, current RISC-V specifications for base integer and multiply/divide semantics, AMD and Intel documentation for hardened DSP resources, and a current publisher record for CMOS VLSI design. All seven authoritative URLs returned HTTP 200. ISA semantics, HDL rules, vendor block behavior, simplified arithmetic models and physical recommendations remain separately scoped.

evidence: Checked width, modulo result, carry, propagate/generate, sign-bit, overflow, zero, negative and initiation-interval notation.

evidence: Recomputed 120+20 as result 140, carry 0, signed result -116 and signed overflow true in eight bits.
Recomputed 200+100 as result 44, carry 1 and no signed overflow, and 3-5 as result 254, borrow 1 and signed -2 without overflow.
